entities.summary: Kay Bailey Hutchison is an American attorney, television correspondent, politician, diplomat, and was the 22nd U.S. permanent representatives to NATO from 2017 until 2021. A member of the Republican Party, she was a United States senator from Texas from 1993 to 2013.
